items.title: Centene (CNC) Stock Still Looks Undervalued On Its 96% Run
items.summary: Centene has delivered a sharp share price run, and that leaves investors asking whether the current valuation is still grounded in its earnings profile. After a move like this, the key issue is whether the market price now fully reflects what the business is earning today. Over the past year the stock is up 96.5%, which puts a lot of weight on whether recent enthusiasm is being matched by underlying profit power.
